meta.title: 4HOPE — Tools for the LATAM TFT community
meta.description: 4HOPE builds tools that make playing, organizing and competing in Teamfight Tactics easier. Starting with TFT Competition Bracket. Made in LATAM, for LATAM.

hero.headline: Play for real. Organize better.
hero.sub: 4HOPE builds tools that make playing, organizing and competing in TFT easier. Made in LATAM, for LATAM.

whatIs.title: A platform made by players
whatIs.lead: 4HOPE is a LATAM platform building tools for Teamfight Tactics and its community. We're starting with a bracket that sets up a tournament in minutes. More tools, events and a competitive team are on the way.

points.title: Built for LATAM
points.body: Made for our servers, our time zones and our community. Spanish first.

points.title: Free for the community
points.body: The tools are free. Use them for your tournaments, scrims and leagues.

points.title: Made by players
points.body: We play TFT. We build what we were missing to organize and compete.

tools.title: Your TFT toolkit
tools.lead: One brand, several tools. Each one lives on its own 4hope.app subdomain.

bracket.desc: Build single-elimination brackets for 2 to 32 players or teams. Advance winners in one click and share the link with your community.

leaderboard.desc: Round-by-round points table for TFT-style tournaments, with a qualifying line and prizes.

lobbies.desc: Find and open community lobbies for scrims, ranked and organized matches.

teams.title: Competitive team
teams.body: We're putting together the 4HOPE competitive team. Follow it on Discord to hear first about tryouts, the roster and matches.

community.title: Join the community
community.body: Run tournaments, find your squad, share your brackets and tell us what to build next.

items.a: A LATAM platform building tools for Teamfight Tactics and its community. The first one is TFT Competition Bracket.
Nothing. 4HOPE tools are free for the community.

items.q: Is 4HOPE an official Riot Games product?
items.a: No. 4HOPE is an independent community project and isn't endorsed by Riot Games.
We're working on round-by-round points tables and community lobbies. Check the Discord for news.
Yes. Message us on Discord or by email and tell us what you need to play or organize.

contact.title: Talk to the squad
contact.lead: Pick what you need and your email app opens with the details ready to fill in.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.metaDescription: How 4HOPE handles your data on 4hope.app: cookie-free analytics and no personal data.

sections.p: 4hope.app doesn't use cookies or browser storage to track you.
We count visits in aggregate with a cookie-free analytics tool. We don't collect personal data or build profiles, and we don't share data with advertisers.
Each tool (for example, bracket.4hope.app) may have its own policy. Check it inside the tool.
If you have privacy questions, email us at our contact address.
